Pixel Agents office integration

Upstream: https://github.com/pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents
Pinned commit: b1bafd02896d90d83457266575a1e8e5011ce997 (v1.5.0)
MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Pablo De Lucca. See LICENSE.

Characters are upstream adaptations of MetroCity by JIK-A-4, CC0-1.0:
https://jik-a-4.itch.io/metrocity-free-topdown-character-pack
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Quantara reuses the original App, office UI, renderer, bundled furniture,
floor/wall/carpet sprites, font and default-layout-1.json. Original source and
asset hashes are recorded in manifest.json. Read-only/accessibility adaptations
are recorded in the build's provenance.json.

A restricted bridge replaces upstream transports. No upstream server, socket,
terminal, host hooks or transcript reader executes. Only eight role labels,
recorded research statuses, selection and animation pause cross the bridge.
